ledger: dancer's right arm and shoulder | extended laterally to the right at 00:00 | curved overhead in a port de bras pose at 00:09 | lifts at 00:01, suffers severe anatomical dislocation/snapping to the left side of the head at 00:02, snaps back to the right shoulder at 00:03, lowers by 00:05, and lifts smoothly overhead from 00:06 to 00:09
dancer's left arm | hanging down by left side at 00:00 | hanging down by left side at 00:09 | remains lowered throughout with minor postural adjustments at the hip between 00:04 and 00:05

dancer's legs and feet on studio floor | right foot planted supporting weight, left foot extended to the left on ball of foot at 00:00 | right foot supporting weight, left foot pointed to the left at 00:09 | stance and pelvic alignment abruptly warp/invert at 00:02 before snapping back at 00:03; feet adjust stance slightly at 00:04-00:05 and extend into a left tendu at 00:08-00:09

findings.description: As the dancer raises her right arm overhead from 00:01 to 00:02, the limb trajectory breaks and the arm snaps across her upper back to protrude vertically from behind her head and left shoulder while her right shoulder slopes downward without an attached arm, before snapping back to an anatomically normal right-arm position at 00:03.

findings.entity: dancer's pelvis, legs, and planted feet
findings.description: At 00:02, the dancer's lower body and floor contact abruptly invert without a stepping transition—her pelvis twists and weight shifts onto a planted left foot with the right leg extended—before snapping back to the original right-foot-weighted stance at 00:03.
